A domain-restricted WebSearch against aighospitals.com for 'Premkumar' plus 'liver transplant anaesthesia AIG' returned https://aighospitals.com/doctor/dr-gv-premkumar with the title 'Dr. G.V. Name + sub-specialty + hospital + city all match the assigned row.

NAME-FORM NOTE: the workbook writes 'Dr. GV. Premkumar' (an odd full stop after the joined initials); AIG's title writes 'Dr. G.V. Premkumar' and AIG's slug compresses the initials to dr-gv-premkumar. These are punctuation-only renderings of the same initials G and V - not different people. This is exactly the AIG initial-reordering/compression behaviour flagged in the method notes.

SLUG TRUSTED OVER TITLE, per the AIG method. The URL is in AIG's canonical singular /doctor/<dr-name-slug> family and the slug matches the assigned name. The page is live - it was NOT returned with a '404 Page Not Found' title. No plural /doctors/ page and no /doctor-profile/ page surfaced for him, and neither was constructed; no translate.goog mirror was needed.

HONEST LIMIT ON WHAT WAS VERIFIED. The search summary for this query was explicit that it could not attribute a specific role or grade to him, even though the AIG listing shows both 'Associate Consultant, Liver Transplant Anaesthesia' and 'Senior Consultant, Liver Transplant Anaesthesia and Intensive Care' as grades existing in that unit. Those grades belong to the DEPARTMENT listing, not demonstrably to him, so neither was written into verified_role as his - a deliberate refusal to upgrade a plausible guess into an asserted fact. Similarly, the '>15 years / >2500 liver transplants' figure on the department page is a TEAM figure and is recorded only as institutional context in hni_signals, never as his personal experience or volume. This is the single most useful thing for a human to resolve on this row.

SAME-NAME CAUTION: 'Premkumar' is common in South India, so the sub-specialty and hospital were required to match explicitly and both do, via the hospital's own domain. No competing AIG doctor of this name surfaced.

CONTACT STATUS: no email address, no phone number, no WhatsApp and no secretary line is published for him anywhere that surfaced. AIG does not publish per-doctor direct lines on its profile pages as a matter of house style, so this is expected rather than a search failure. professional_email and professional_phone are blank rather than guessed, and no address was pattern-derived from the aighospitals.com domain. The pipeline's automatic AIG hospital-level fallback is the correct switchboard route. No broker, scraped or masked contact was encountered for this row.
